title: Export application settings

request.text: мне нужна функция экспорт настроек приложения

decision: Add one export-only panel action that downloads Toolcraft's canonical settings JSON v3 from the immutable action state snapshot.
result: Settings Export now downloads the current Toolcraft JSON v3 state through the existing runtime serializer; focused unit and browser verification passed.
checks: TypeScript passed and the focused product/render-plan suite passed 5 tests.
Raw browser download verified filename, JSON v3 identity, plate gap, pose, canvas and timeline fields.
Protected test:feature selection settings.export passed, journal run fa727559-47e1-40ed-8613-9babff320e0c.
Embedded Browser shows the Settings Export section and Export Settings button on localhost:3003.
risks: The generated standalone runtime normally exposes Save as Defaults instead of settings-file transfer; this explicit app feature remains export-only.
